question: A cricketer has an average of 88 runs over 10 innings. If he scores 219 runs in the 11th inning, by how many runs (rounded off to the nearest whole number) does his average score increase?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Old total = 88 × 10 = 880

New total = 880 + 219 = 1099

New average = 1099 ÷ 11 ≈ 99.91

Increase = 99.91 − 88 ≈ 11.91 ≈ 12

**∴ Answer = 12 runs**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average for 10 innings = 88

Score in 11th inning = 219

**Formula used:**

Total = Average × Number of innings

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total runs in 10 innings = 88 × 10 = 880

⇒ Total runs in 11 innings = 880 + 219 = 1099

⇒ New average = 1099 ÷ 11

⇒ ≈ 99.91

⇒ Increase in average = 99.91 − 88

⇒ ≈ 11.91

⇒ Rounded off = 12

**∴ The correct answer is 12 runs.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Formula

Average = Total ÷ Number of observations

Total Calculation

Total = Average × Count

Change in Average

New average − Old average gives increase or decrease.

Shortcut Insight

If new score is much higher than average, average increases significantly.
